# Arrays {.unnumbered}

## Declaring

```c
int  a[10];                     /* 10 ints, values undefined   */
int  b[5] = {1,2,3,4,5};
int  c[5] = {0};                /* first 0, rest also 0        */
int  d[]  = {1,2,3};            /* size taken from the list: 3 */
int  m[3][4];                   /* 3 rows, 4 columns           */
```

Indices run `0 … n-1`. `a[10]` in an array of 10 is **out of bounds** — undefined behaviour, and C will not stop you.

## sizeof — and where it stops working

```
in main:    sizeof a = 40      (10 ints)
inside f:   sizeof a = 8       (a pointer)
```

```c
void f(int a[]) { /* sizeof a is the POINTER size here */ }
```

| | |
|---|---|
| number of elements, where declared | `sizeof a / sizeof a[0]` |
| inside a function | **impossible** — pass the length |

This is why every array function takes a length:

```c
void f(int a[], int n)
```

## 2-D

```
sizeof m        = 48      (3 × 4 × 4)
sizeof m[0]     = 16      (one row)
sizeof m[0][0]  = 4
rows = sizeof m / sizeof m[0] = 3
```

Stored **row after row**. To reach `m[i][j]` the machine computes `i*COLS + j` — which is why:

| parameter | |
|---|---|
| `int m[3][4]` | fine |
| `int m[][4]` | fine — rows not needed |
| `int m[3][]` | **rejected** |
| `int m[][]` | **rejected** |

The **column** count is part of the type and travels with the parameter. The **row** count does not.

## Passing to a function

| | |
|---|---|
| an array argument becomes a **pointer** to its first element | no copy is made |
| so the function **can change** the caller's elements | |
| and no `&` is written at the call | `f(a)`, not `f(&a)` |
| `int a[]` and `int *a` in a parameter list | mean the same thing |

## Walking

```c
for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)      /* by index   */
    …a[i]…

int *p = a;                       /* by pointer */
…*(p + i)…                        /* same as a[i] */
```

`a[i]` **is** `*(a + i)`.

## Traps

| | |
|---|---|
| `a[n]` where the array has `n` | one past the end |
| `sizeof` inside a function | gives the pointer size |
| forgetting the length parameter | the function cannot recover it |
| `int a[n]` with `n` read at run time | avoid; fixed sizes until `malloc` in W13 |
| comparing arrays with `==` | compares addresses, not contents |
